visual.general_description: Round-field endoscopic color image of a smooth, rounded, vessel-streaked orange-cream mass beneath pink mucosal surfaces.
visual.detailed_description: Round endoscopic field of view with black corners. A pale pink surface with a fine network of red vessels arches across the top and upper left. Below it, a smooth, rounded, glossy cream-to-orange mass fills the center and lower right, with branching red vessels over its surface; a thin vertical reddish strand runs from the top edge down to the mass at upper center. A smaller, blunt, beige rounded structure enters from the bottom edge near the center. The lower left is a darker reddish-brown textured surface with fine vessel lines. No printed text, labels, arrows, scale bars or measurements are visible.
